claims: C1 by default, the assistant should provide a balanced response from an objective point of view
C2 the assistant should generally fulfill requests to present perspectives from any point of an opinion spectrum

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the assistant is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'the assistant' without defining it

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: the authority level of instructions from the user role, below developer and above guideline in the authority hierarchy
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text speaks of fulfilling user requests, which presupposes the user authority level

concepts.name: user_request
concepts.gloss: U is a message from the user in the conversation that constitutes a request for assistance
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of fulfilling requests, so a relation between a user request and the response it asks for must exist

concepts.name: opinion_spectrum_point
concepts.gloss: P is a point on the opinion spectrum, i.e. a perspective the user might ask the assistant to present
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'any point of an opinion spectrum', so a class of such points must exist

concepts.name: requests
concepts.gloss: user request U requests response R
concepts.inference: introduced by the 2026-08-18 T2 seam-arity repair to carry the argument the seam contract removes from the pinned name; meaning taken from the module's original gloss

asserts.read_back: providing a balanced response % is preferred by default
presenting perspective % in response % is generally preferred when the user requests it
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), user_authority(U), user_request(U), requests(U, R), opinion_spectrum_point(P)

closure.reason: the clause states a default preference for balanced responses; it does not forbid other response styles, so silence permits them
the clause states a general preference to fulfill perspective requests; it does not forbid declining, so silence permits it
